## Mathematical Statistics (Statistical Inference)

**Term:** Spring 2025 (39 students), Spring 2026 (57 students)  
**Instructor:** Yun Wei

## Course description

Undergraduate course on mathematical statistics (statistical inference).

## Textbooks

- George Casella and Roger L. Berger, *Statistical Inference*, 2nd edition.
- Hyunwoong Chang's lecture notes (other reference).
